findings.title: Admin authorization check is disabled by or True
findings.evidence: The added condition is 'if not (request.user.is_staff or True):'; because 'or True' always yields a truthy value, 'not (...)' is always False and the PermissionDenied branch is unreachable for non-staff and anonymous users.
findings.recommendation: Remove the 'or True' short-circuit and restore the staff check, or explicitly include the intended alternate condition such as 'request.user.is_superuser'; add a regression test asserting that a non-staff user receives PermissionDenied.
